title: 第5章
slug: 鍗挎湰榛戣悓涔嬪栧冩潵琚
content_zh: 第005章 竟然要被赶走宋雪衣，你值得最好的。青草地上穿着黛青色衣裙的女孩儿，生得一双圆溜溜的灵动眸子，小小鼻子薄薄的嘴唇，并不是绝美的美人胚子，笑起来却给人一种春花灿烂，万物静好的感受。她的声音不像是普通孩子那么清脆，反而有点清凉的味道，宛若夏日的凉风，林间干净的露水，无声无息的深入人心，透彻得叫人无法升起丝毫的防备。她对他说：宋雪衣，你值得最好的。理所当然的口气，在他长久没有起伏的心海中激起惊涛骇浪，使得他在那一刻，脑海空白。“雪衣，雪衣？”“嗯？”宋雪衣面具后的嘴唇扬了扬。居然走神想起小鸠儿了，不知道她现在在做什么，昨日居然忘记她在宋家做什么，看衣服打扮不似宋家的婢女，会是哪个嬷嬷的女儿吗。“雪衣！”孙谷兰奇怪看着眼前面具白衣的少年。这已经是他第三次走神了！“嗯。”宋雪衣表情都隐藏在面具之后，如果不是这次他走神的太严重，一般人根本就发现不了。孙谷兰关切的问道：“发生什么事情了吗？娘叫你几次都不见你答应。”宋雪衣低声道：“娘唤孩儿来，是为了什么？”孙谷兰叹了一口气，“之前你根本就没有听娘说话吧。”心中不免奇怪，这世上还有什么事能惹得雪衣这么在意，竟然走神的这么厉害。“娘提起了卿家的女儿。”宋雪衣淡道。“没错，就是卿家的那个女孩儿。”孙谷兰慈爱的说道：“那孩子已经跟着辛嬷嬷学习了两个多月，年纪虽然不大却是个心细乖巧的，应该能合你的眼。”“送回去吧。”宋雪衣道。“什么？”孙谷兰诧异站起来，“那孩子能旺你，雪衣，娘知道你不喜欢外人靠近，可这孩子……先试试可好？倘若真的不喜欢，看着碍眼，娘再将人送走。”宋雪衣轻轻摇头，“她是在用自己的性命旺我。娘，将她送回去。”宋雪衣，你值得最好的……鸠儿，我并不如你看到的那么好。既然你这样认为，我便顺着你想的那般想的做好了。卿家女孩儿如何，我本不在意。不过听闻她与你年纪一般大小，那就开口为她博得一条生路吧。“……好。”孙谷兰无奈的叹气。抬头却见宋雪衣已经站起身，准备离去，她不由的开口，“雪衣，你这是去哪？今日外面下雨不要走远。还有，最近是发生什么了吗，有什么事就跟娘说，这个家里唯有娘是你最能信任的人。”宋雪衣顿足，“好事。”不知道是想到了什么，一声低笑冒出来，又强调的喟叹一句，“很好的事。”无尘的白衣划过门槛，消失在门后，只剩下房间里呆愣的孙谷兰一人，惊疑不定的呢喃，“雪衣，这是笑了？真的高兴的笑？”雨皖坊是灵鸠居住的地方，这里不止有她还有别的宋家买来的幼童，打小就培养他们成为宋家的死忠婢女奴仆。这时刚完成辛嬷嬷任务的灵鸠正坐在围栏上，双腿闲闲的晃荡着，望着外面滴滴答答的落雨。这个天气，宋雪衣应该不会去那里了吧。“小鸠！小鸠！这鬼影儿，又跑哪里去了！”远远的听到辛嬷嬷的叫声。灵鸠灵巧的跳下围栏，整理好衣服，一路小跑没多久就看到一个穿着深蓝色长裙的中年妇女。在妇女没注意到之前，已经放缓了脚步，调整好表情，声音不大不小的叫道：“嬷嬷，我在这里。”辛嬷嬷停下脚步，招手道：“快跟我过来，有大事。”灵鸠表面乖巧的跟随，将辛嬷嬷复杂眼神看得清楚，心想发生了什么大事，难道是宋雪衣决定提前把她要过去了？两人进房间里，灵鸠敏锐的注意到房间桌子上摆放着的东西。一张卖身契，一张银票。“小鸠，大少爷那边传来消息，说是不想要你，要将你送回去。”辛嬷嬷开门见山的说道。两个月的相处，她已经看出来眼前七岁女孩儿乖巧后的聪慧，和她说话不需要太多的拐弯抹角。灵鸠一怔，然后眼睛微微瞪大，再慢慢的恢复，最后眼底浮现一丝怒火和失望。宋雪衣，好你一个宋雪衣，难得姐真心实意的打算把你当弟弟疼，一晚上都在想你身体的问题，想着怎么呵护你。你倒好，一句话不要！不要的话，昨天答应干嘛！玩姐吗！“哎。”最终，灵鸠张嘴，只叹了一口气。她跟一个十几岁的孩子生什么气，那不是太没风度了吗。如果让现代那群和她有过些许接触的人，得知她这样的想法一定会笑掉大牙。现代道界里谁不知道天眼者灵鸠是个睚眦必报的人，管你年纪大小，只要惹她不高兴了一定有你好受。她会因为你年纪小觉得没风度就不跟你置气了？别开玩笑了！如果真发生这样的情况，只有一个可能，就是那个人合她的眼缘，让她根本无法对那人置气。辛嬷嬷觉得七岁的小孩一脸无奈纠结的叹气模样实在好笑，脸上也真的露出了笑容，不过想到接下来的事，她的笑容又消减了，对灵鸠道：“看到桌上的东西了吗？大夫人心善，给了你两个选择。一个是继续留在宋家，在大夫人的院里当值，做个上等的小丫头。一个是拿着你的卖身契，还有这一百两的银票，自己离去，至于去哪里，随你的意。”灵鸠没有犹豫多久，走上前伸手去拿卖身契和银票。辛嬷嬷不由道：“小鸠，听嬷嬷一句话。嬷嬷知道你之前是卿家的小姐，可在卿家的日子并不好过。如果跟在大夫人身边，这吃喝住行都不会比你以前差。”见灵鸠丝毫无所动的样子，辛嬷嬷心急得略微站起身子，“诶，你这孩子怎么关键时候就发傻呢，你才多大，拿了一百两银子出去能做什么，说不定一出宋家的门没一会就被人……”灵鸠已经把卖身契和银票拿在手里，昂头对辛嬷嬷笑道：“嬷嬷，我没那么傻。”你真当我是七岁小鬼吗，还有你以为我这段日子修炼前世的无名功法是摆设的吗。这些话灵鸠没有对辛嬷嬷说，不过她的表情已经表露出她的决心。“你这孩子！”辛嬷嬷呲牙咧嘴，却只吐出这句憋闷的话。灵鸠扬了扬手里的卖身契，“那嬷嬷，我走了。”“走什么走，衣服不要了？吃食不要了？呸！”一看听到吃的灵鸠才发亮的眼睛，辛嬷嬷又好气又好笑，笑骂道：“你这是小贪嘴儿，要是出了宋家，可没有这么多好吃食。”灵鸠眼珠子左看看，右看看，好似没有听出辛嬷嬷的暗示。她本身是个随遇而安的人，本打算成年前留在宋家，可人家都赶人了，她又何必再留。宋雪衣，这个第一眼让她产生怜惜的少年，也让她原本随遇而安的心态有那么一瞬的改变，是真想着好好呵护他成长。可人家不需要啊！不、需、要、啊……灵鸠悄然的垂眸，她不会承认她有那么一瞬的难过酸涩。这又是被嫌弃抛弃了呗，算了，也不是第一次了，算个什么事。天下之大，还怕没她灵鸠的安居之所吗。这里又不是现代，没有黑心的房地产商，她随便寻个地，买几车木头搭一个房子就她的窝了，没有物业费管理费水电费，多轻松自在。灵鸠越想越觉得好，已经开始构思地方装修的问题。
content_en: Chapter 005 Song Xueyi is about to be driven away, you deserve the best. The girl wearing a dark blue dress on the green grass has a pair of round and smart eyes, a small nose and thin lips. She is not a beautiful embryo, but her smile gives people a feeling of bright spring flowers and tranquility of all things. Her voice is not as crisp as an ordinary child's, but has a cool flavor, like the cool breeze in summer or the clean dew in the forest. It penetrates deeply into people's hearts silently and is so thorough that it makes people unable to raise the slightest precaution. She said to him: Song Xueyi, you deserve the best. The matter-of-fact tone stirred up turmoil in his heart, which had been stable for a long time, making his mind go blank at that moment. "Xueyi, Xueyi?" "Huh?" Song Xueyi raised her lips behind the mask. I actually lost my mind and thought about Xiao Jiu'er. I don't know what she is doing now. I actually forgot what she was doing at the Song family yesterday. The clothes don't look like the maids of the Song family. Could she be the daughter of some grandma? "Xueyi!" Sun Gulan looked at the young man wearing a mask and white clothes in front of him strangely. This is the third time he has been distracted! "Yeah." Song Xueyi's expression was hidden behind the mask. If he hadn't been so distracted this time, most people wouldn't have noticed it. Sun Gulan asked with concern: "What happened? Mom asked you several times but you didn't agree." Song Xueyi whispered: "Why did mom call the baby here?" Sun Gulan sighed, "You didn't listen to mom at all before." She couldn't help but wonder, what else in this world could make Xueyi pay so much attention to, and be so distracted. "Mom mentioned the Qing family's daughter." Song Xueyi said calmly. "Yes, she is the girl from the Qing family." Sun Gulan said lovingly: "That child has been studying with Grandma Xin for more than two months. Although she is not old, she is careful and well-behaved. She should be able to suit your eyes." "Send it back." Song Xueyi said. "What?" Sun Gulan stood up in surprise, "That child can make you happy, Xueyi, mother knows that you don't like outsiders to get close to you, but this child... How about trying it first? If you really don't like it and it looks like an eyesore, mother will send him away." Song Xueyi shook her head gently, "She is using her life to make me happy. Mother, send her back." Song Xueyi, you deserve the best... Jiu'er, I am not as good as you see. Since you think so, I will do what you want. I don't care what happens to the girls from the Qing family. But I heard that she is about the same age as you, so speak up and try to find a way out for her. "...Okay." Sun Gulan sighed helplessly. When she raised her head, she saw that Song Xueyi had already stood up and was about to leave. She couldn't help but said, "Xueyi, where are you going? It's raining outside today. Don't go too far. Also, what happened recently? If anything happens, just tell your mother. She is the only person you can trust most in this family." Song Xueyi paused, "Good thing." She didn't know what she thought of, but she laughed softly and emphasized. He sighed, "It's a good thing." The dust-free white clothes crossed the threshold and disappeared behind the door, leaving only the stunned Sun Gulan in the room, murmuring in surprise, "Xueyi, is this a smile? A really happy smile?" Yuwanfang is where Lingjiu lives. Not only does she live here, there are other children bought by the Song family, who have been trained since they were young to become loyal maidservants of the Song family. At this time, Lingjiu, who had just completed the task of Aunt Xin, was sitting on the fence, her legs dangling leisurely, looking at the dripping rain outside. In this weather, Song Xueyi probably won't go there. "Xiaojiu! Xiaojiu! Where did this ghost go?" Nanny Xin's cry was heard in the distance. Lingjiu nimbly jumped off the fence, arranged her clothes, and soon after trotting along she saw a middle-aged woman wearing a dark blue dress. Before the woman noticed, she had already slowed down, adjusted her expression, and shouted in a moderate voice: "Mommy, I'm here." Nanny Xin stopped and waved, "Come with me quickly, there's something big going on." Lingjiu followed obediently, seeing Nanny Xin's complex eyes clearly, and wondered what big thing had happened. Could it be that Song Xueyi decided to take her over in advance? When the two entered the room, Lingjiu keenly noticed the things placed on the table in the room. A deed of sale and a banknote. "Xiaojiu, there is news from the eldest young master that he doesn't want you and wants to send you back." Aunt Xin said straight to the point. After two months of getting along, she could already see the cleverness of the well-behaved seven-year-old girl in front of her, and she didn't need to mince words when talking to her. Lingjiu was startled, then his eyes widened slightly, then slowly recovered, and finally there was a trace of anger and disappointment in his eyes. Song Xueyi, you are such a good Song Xueyi. It’s rare that I sincerely intend to treat you as my little brother. I have been thinking about your health all night and how to take care of you. You'd better not say a word! If not, why did you agree yesterday? Are you playing sister? "Hey." Finally, Lingjiu opened his mouth and sighed. Why should she be angry with a teenager? Isn't that very rude? If the modern people who had had some contact with her would laugh out loud at her thoughts like this. Who in the modern Taoist world doesn't know that Lingjiu, the Sky-Eyed Master, is a person who is determined to retaliate. No matter how old you are, as long as you make her unhappy, you will definitely feel better. Will she stop getting angry with you because you are young and think you have no grace? No kidding! If such a situation really happened, there was only one possibility, that is, that person was so close to her that she could not be angry with him at all. Grandma Xin found the helpless and entangled sigh of the seven-year-old child really funny, and a smile really appeared on her face. However, thinking of what happened next, her smile faded again, and she said to Lingjiu: "Did you see what is on the table? The eldest lady is kind-hearted and gave you two choices. One is to continue to stay in the Song family.
